title: Meridional flows in the disk around a young star
question: What are the three-dimensional gas velocity components (v_phi, v_R, v_Z) in the upper layers of the HD 163296 disk, and do they show meridional flows at the gap locations?

what.value: Disk inclination 46.7 +/- 0.1 deg and PA 133.3 deg from continuum ring fits

evidence.quote: we adopt the inclination and position angle found from continuum(cite: Isella_ea_2018), $i = 46.7\ensuremath{^\circ}$
assuming a source distance of 101 pc(cite: Bailer-Jones_ea_2018)

recipe.method: Fit a quadratic to the peak pixel and its two neighbours to get line-centre maps
Fit the Keplerian map with a two-power-law emission surface and 10 free parameters
key_parameters: Only pixels at least a beam FWHM apart are used in the likelihood

recipe.method: Pinte et al. 2018a method with a Gaussian Process on the raw points
assumptions: Circular orbits; i = 46.7 deg, PA = 133.3 deg

recipe.goal: Measure v_phi and v_R in annuli
recipe.method: Annuli 25 mas wide; random independent pixels; maximise the Gaussian Process likelihood of the shifted and stacked spectra; 20 realisations per annulus

recipe.goal: Measure v_Z from the line centre
recipe.method: Resample the stacked spectra to 40 m/s and fit a Gaussian, first to the whole spectrum and then to the line core; the line centre is v_LSR plus v_Z,proj
key_parameters: Resampled to 40 m/s, a factor of 16 higher than the original data

recipe.goal: Subtract background rotation and convert to Mach number
recipe.method: Fit a 10th-order polynomial to v_phi as a baseline; derive temperature from the peak brightness with the full Planck law and compute the sound speed
assumptions: Line is optically thick; brightness temperature traces gas temperature

recipe.method: FARGO3D isothermal simulation with three planets for 1.44 Myr
key_parameters: Grid 256x36x635; r = 32.1 to 401.5 au; alpha = 1e-3; Mgas = 0.09 Msun

answer_key.quantity: Statistical uncertainty on v_phi and v_R

evidence.quote: The resulting statistical uncertainties on $v_{\phi}$ and $v_{R}$ are $\sim$ ${10}~{\rm m\,s^{-1}}$

answer_key.value: ~90 K inside 30 au to 30 K at 400 au

evidence.quote: finding values spanning between $\approx 90$ K in the inner 30 au and dropping to 30 K at 400 au

not_stated_but_needed: Exact DSHARP image product (file name, robust weighting) of the 12CO cube
Choice of Delta V for the line-core fit
Radial range and number of annuli used, and the polynomial fitting range
Emission-surface parameters for gas-temperature and sound-speed conversion beyond the description
FARGO3D setup details such as boundary conditions and the smoothing of the planet potential
missing_for_reproduction: Exact DSHARP cube file and Delta V for the line-core fit
Simulation boundary conditions and planet potential smoothing
score_reason: Public images and public code with posterior values and settings given; a few details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: The data are public, the recipe is largely complete, and the results are numeric.
